meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文字、数据或品牌标志变成几秒钟的动效短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用几秒钟的动效视频讲清一个点,又不想动专业剪辑软件。
copy.tagline_en: Turn text, stats, or a brand mark into a few-second animated clip
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a few-second animated video that makes one point, without pro editing tools.

howto.what: Claude 会做一段以动效本身传达信息的短片:动态文字、数字滚动、图表、logo 亮相、下三分之一字幕、动画地图、动画推文或网页 UI 等,通常不足 10 秒、无旁白,输出 MP4 或透明叠加视频。
howto.when: 当你需要一段不足 10 秒、没有旁白和实拍人物的设计导向动效时触发;内容更长、带旁白或多场景会转 /general-video,拿不准先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我做一段 10 秒的动态文字短片
say.note: 进入 kinetic-type 流程,先出镜头方案

say.text: 把这份数据做成 5 秒的柱状图动画
say.note: 走 charts 类别,可跳过素材检索

say.text: 给我的 logo 做一个品牌亮相动效
say.note: 走 logo-reveal,用你提供的 logo

howto.what_en: Claude produces a short, design-led motion graphic where motion carries the message — kinetic type, stat count-up, chart, logo sting, lower-third, animated map/tweet/webpage. Usually under 10s, no narration, rendered as MP4 or transparent overlay.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a short (under ~10s), unnarrated, design-led motion graphic. Longer, narrated, or multi-scene pieces go to /general-video; if unclear, start at /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make me a 10-second kinetic typography clip
say_en.note: Runs the kinetic-type flow, starts with a shot plan

say_en.text: Turn this data into a 5-second bar chart animation
say_en.note: Uses the charts category, no asset search needed

say_en.text: Animate a brand reveal for my logo
say_en.note: Runs logo-reveal with the logo you supply
